tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background (Rice). Default ground for every screen.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the tool panel, FAQ items, inputs. Sits on surface-page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inside the dropzone and other recessed areas within a card.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Ink blocks: the privacy band, the footer, the code panel. Text on it: ink-on-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: Cards placed on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-page, surface-card and every brand block (light theme). 15:1+ on surface-page.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, hints. ≥6:1 on surface-page and surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-on-block
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand block (mango, strawberry, matcha, ube) in BOTH themes: blocks stay vivid, text stays ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and quiet outlines (FAQ rules, footer rule). Not for control borders.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control on its own (unselected chips, outline buttons, inputs at rest). ≥3:1 on surface-page and surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: The dashed dropzone outline (decorative; the dropzone also has a visible label and button).

tokens.name: mango
tokens.usage: Identity block. Image tools category, the default hero block, selected size chip.

tokens.name: strawberry
tokens.usage: Identity block. Brand moments, Premium, PDF category, first i-dot of the wordmark. Never means 'error'.

tokens.name: matcha
tokens.usage: Identity block. Success states ('Ready!'), second i-dot of the wordmark.

tokens.name: ube
tokens.usage: Identity block. Video and audio category, the mascot's folded corner, information notices. Kept identical in dark so ink text keeps ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: mango-tint
tokens.usage: Soft ground: image tool icon tiles, 'resized' notices, the active TOC item.

tokens.name: strawberry-tint
tokens.usage: Soft ground: PDF tool icon tiles and chips.

tokens.name: matcha-tint
tokens.usage: Soft ground: success notices ('Metadata removed').

tokens.name: ube-tint
tokens.usage: Soft ground: video/audio icon tiles, info notices ('Saved as JPG').

tokens.name: mango-ink
tokens.usage: Text on mango-tint.

tokens.name: strawberry-ink
tokens.usage: Text on strawberry-tint.

tokens.name: matcha-ink
tokens.usage: Text on matcha-tint and on matcha blocks in light theme.

tokens.name: ube-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ube-tint.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (pill buttons, selected segment). Inverts in dark: a cream pill on the dark ground.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only: invalid file, failed processing. Deliberately an orange-red, distinct from strawberry in hue AND lightness.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of error notices.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of attention notices (alias of mango-tint).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-tint (alias of mango-ink).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px, offset 2px, on every interactive element. Blue so it never reads as a brand or state colour.

tokens.name: mochi-body
tokens.usage: Mascot and symbol body. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: mochi-outline
tokens.usage: Mascot outline and face. Same in both themes: the mascot always sits on a brand block or a light disc, never directly on the dark ground.

tokens.name: mochi-blush
tokens.usage: Mascot cheeks.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Site V2: links, eyebrows, the soft button's label and the credit link. Deep ube, 6.9:1 on surface-page. Never a button fill: that stays action.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Site V2: active navigation item background.

tokens.name: card-line
tokens.usage: Site V2: hairline border of cards, soft buttons, chips and the menu button. Decorative, like line; a control that needs a 3:1 border uses border-control.

tokens.name: dot-red
tokens.usage: Site V2: the red dot of the wordmark's first i, repeated in the section underline dots.

tokens.name: dot-green
tokens.usage: Site V2: the green dot of the wordmark's second i, repeated in the section underline dots.

tokens.name: heart
tokens.usage: Site V2: the footer heart and the Sponsor badge icon (AA on surface-page and surface-card).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Tool page and hero H1 from 600px up.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section heroes and large headings from 600px up; steps down to title under 600px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: H2 section titles; also the tool page H1 under 600px.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: H3, card titles, category headings.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Primary button labels, numbered step labels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Escolha o tamanho, solte suas fotos e baixe cópias que cabem no limite.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under an H1.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text. Never below 16px for body copy.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: FAQ questions, tool card titles at small sizes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: JPG, PNG ou WebP · até 20 fotos
styles.usage: Hints, dropzone meta, chip and notice labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Breadcrumbs, tags, eyebrow labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code samples on the API page.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Site V2: header links and the language button.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Site V2: small pill buttons.

styles.name: footer-link
styles.usage: Site V2: footer link columns.

styles.name: footer-small
styles.usage: Site V2: footer company, legal and language links; menu language chips.

styles.name: footer-note
styles.usage: Site V2: the Ask AI line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Site V2: small uppercase labels (letter-spaced).

styles.name: footer-heading
styles.usage: Site V2: footer column headings (uppercase, letter-spaced).

styles.name: badge-label
styles.usage: Site V2: the small line of a footer badge (uppercase, letter-spaced).

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Site V2: large pill buttons (phone menu).

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Site V2: language chips in the phone menu.

styles.name: credit
styles.usage: Site V2: the footer credit line.

styles.name: menu-link
styles.usage: Site V2: phone menu links.

styles.name: badge-title
styles.usage: Site V2: the main line of a footer badge.

tokens.usage: Card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-14

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control; menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, icon tiles (16-18px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, notices blocks, FAQ items.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Brand blocks, the tool panel, dropzone.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero blocks, the inverse band, footer top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, the language switcher.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons and the search field.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Square icon tile on tool cards.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of long-form text.

tokens.name: site-header
tokens.usage: Site V2: height of the header row on every screen.

tokens.name: site-max
tokens.usage: Site V2: max width of the header and footer, gutters included (32px, 20px under 600px).
